bull_bear.body:
- Conservative leverage philosophy is explicit: "CONSERVATIVE LEVERAGE THRESHOLD 1.5-2X in Wholesale & <4X in SME Retail"; leverage ratio stood at "a comfortable 1.39x as on 30th June 2026 with total outstanding borrowings of Rs 884.07 crore", against CAR of 42.90%.
- Conservative provisioning stance: "it follows conservative provisioning standards i.e. 1% of AUM against regulatory requirement of 0.4%"; the stage-analysis slide adds "Change in ECL Provisioning policy in line with the changes suggested by RBI."
- Governance slide cites "9 years of uninterrupted Dividends", an independent board, and "Transparent & proactive investor communication".
- Equity has been raised sparingly and episodically: Rs 54 crore in FY18, Rs 30 crore in FY22 and Rs 48 crore in FY24.
- ESOP Policy 2025: "100% of the CSL Employee Stock Option Plan 2025 pool remains ungranted" as grants are linked to performance milestones, so "there has been limited equity dilution on this account".
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Described as "a one-stop destination for Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises (SMEs) and real estate and non-real estate corporates to avail a variety of secured loan products"; a Non-Banking Finance Company registered with the RBI and listed on NSE and BSE.
- Business model rests on five stated pillars: Domain Expertise, Focused Strategy, Customer-Centric, Technology-Driven, and lending to "Healthy Businesses ... who lack access to traditional finance sources".
- SME Retail differentiators: target market of the "unbanked & underserved", alternative data instead of conventional scorecards, small and flexible ticket sizes, 100% secured book, quality collateral ("91% is SORP & 9% is SOCP") and financial inclusion with "50% AUM from non-Urban locations".
- Wholesale differentiators: "Niche and focused real estate wholesale book" built on in-depth expertise of NCR micro-markets, primarily last-mile funding to reduce project execution risk, at least 2X security cover with a charge on multiple assets, escrow-based collections, and strength in affordable housing.
- Wholesale risk framework includes fortnightly site visits, review of sales/inventories/market price/costs, early-warning detection and, where required, early legal action; the deck notes "majority of the book being SARFAESI compliant".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Credit rating] The deck carries two framings: the Treasury slide says the rating "has been reaffirmed as A- | Stable from Acuite Ratings & Research as on 31st March, 2026", while Strategic Priorities says it was "reaffirmed at A- | Stable by Acuite Ratings & Research, an upgrade from the previous BBB+ | Stable by India Ratings & Research" and Key Takeaways says "CSL's credit rating has been upgraded to A- Stable".
- [Funding] Lender base "now stands at 35, spanning leading public and private sector banks, SFBs and NBFCs"; against the recent NCD issue "Rs 60 crore has been drawn to date, with a further Rs 90 crore available", and the Company "has raised Rs 50.0 crore from existing lender".
- [Liquidity/ALM] "The Company has sufficient liquidity of Rs 89.5 crore as on 30th June 2026" plus an undrawn NCD facility of Rs 90.0 crore, and "The Company has positive ALM across all the buckets."
- [Asset quality] ECL Provision % on Stage 3 rose to 36.77% in Q1FY27 from 25.80% in Q4FY26 and 25.00% in Q1FY26, with Provision Coverage Ratio at 123.20% (121.57% in Q4FY26, 201.40% in Q1FY26).
- [Leadership] Managing Director Rohit Gupta, a Chartered Accountant with "nearly 3 decades of experience", is described as "the prime driving force behind the structured lending model of the Company"; the board includes ex-Punjab & Sind Bank CFO and ex-SBI Global Factors credit head independent directors.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions CSL Finance as an RBI-registered, NSE/BSE-listed NBFC running a 100% secured loan book across two verticals - a granular SME Retail LAP business for the "unbanked & underserved" and a niche NCR-focused real-estate Wholesale book - underwritten with conservative leverage and provisioning.
